Class Clipping

java.lang.Object
com.eco.bio7.spatial.Clipping
public class Clipping extends Object
Clipping of the volume and the iso surface in the 3D view (to make the interior visible):
  • A clipping box: the parts outside of the box are removed (relative positions 0 - 1 in the extent of the displayed data).
  • A free cutting plane (azimuth, elevation and offset). The part on the front side of the plane is removed (flip removes the other side).
  • A slice: the cross-section of the plane with the data (the colors of the volume, see VolumeRenderer) and the outline of the plane.
The clipping uses the OpenGL clip planes (fast, only the display is clipped). With setCutMesh the iso surface mesh is cut (closed with caps, the export contains the cut surface).

Voxels can be removed with a mask (cuts with an ImageJ selection, a mask image or an array, see cutRoi and setMask). The mask is applied to the volume and to the mesh of the iso surface.
